emails.subject: AI internship at DeepKlarity
emails.body:
Hi DeepKlarity team,

Your Antipatterns section says you model token costs upfront and build provider-agnostic so swapping models doesn't mean rewriting the pipeline.

I built MedVault, a Django backend that runs lab reports through a Gemini pipeline with a fixed JSON schema and a fallback parser for bad model output: https://medvault-xor.vercel.app

I just finished an SDET internship at Basepair, where I fixed a production OAuth race condition, and I'm looking for an internship or entry-level role I can start right away. Does the team take on an engineering intern?
